## Routes

| Route | Heard as | Carries | Level | Until recorded |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `radio` | squad dialogue: your own soldier as your own; a squadmate near you where they stand, dry; one farther off over the radio, one voice at a time | 25 m in the open, then the radio | 0 dB | `radio-chirp` — a PLACEHOLDER, not a voice |
| `body` | a body’s own sound: where the body is, never over the radio; involuntary, so it neither waits for nor holds up the soldier’s words | 15 m | -3 dB | silence |
| `shout` | an enemy calling out: where it stands, dry, in the enemy’s voices; never over the radio | 80 m | 0 dB | silence |
